Compose the default Study runtime with an explicit complete adapter table, removing import-order registration. Existing facades share the same lazily constructed runtime and retain receipt-first recovery for retired command kinds.

A small runtime coalescing fix reserves each recovery before asynchronous retained-kind validation, preserving overlapping callers and original receipt ownership. Six focused suites passed 267 tests, including fresh single-caller imports, all six facade import orders and retained retired commands. Browser typecheck passed. Independent architecture/correctness review and coordinated assembled replay proof remain pending.
